verified.name: 1X Technologies
verified.description: Norwegian-American robotics company developing general-purpose humanoid robots for home environments. The company produces humanoid robots including EVE (for industrial use) and NEO (for residential use).
verified.notes: Company was originally founded as Halodi Robotics in 2014 and rebranded as 1X Technologies in 2022. Series A2 funding of $23.5M in March 2023 led by OpenAI Startup Fund. Series B funding of $100M in January 2024 led by EQT Ventures. Manufacturing operations in Hayward, California and Moss, Norway. NEO pre-orders opened October 28, 2025 at $20,000 with planned 2026 release.
